blocks.tamil_translation: I would not like to imitate him as he did.” he said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: أَتَدْرُوْنَ مَا الْغِيْبَةُ؟ قَالُوْا: اَللهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ اَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: ذِكْرُكَ اَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ قِيْلَ: اَفَرَاَيْتَ اِنْ كَانَ فِيْ اَخِيْ مَا اَقُوْلُ؟ قَالَ: اِنْ كَانَ فِيْهِ مَا تَقُوْلُ، فَقَدِ اغْتَبْتَهُ، وَاِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيْهِ، فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب تحريم الغيبة، رقم: ٦٥٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Rasulullah asked the Sahabah (RA), “Do you know what backbiting is?” The Sahabah (RA) said, “Allah and His Rasul know best.'” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Speaking about your (Muslim) brother (in his absence) with words that he dislikes (this is backbiting).” A Sahabi asked, “If I mention a fault that is in my brother, is that backbiting?” Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “If the fault you mention is in him, you have backbitten him (whatever you say). If that fault is not in him, you have slandered him.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ ذَكَرَ امْرَأً بِشَيْءٍ لَيْسَ فِيْهِ لِيَعِيْبَهُ بِهِ حَبَسَهُ اللهُ فِيْ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ حَتَّي يَأْتِيَ بِنَفَاذِ مَا قَالَ فِيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله ثقات، مجمع الزوائد:٣٦٤/٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever, in order to disgrace another, mentions a fault about him that is not in him, Allah Ta'ala will keep him imprisoned in the fire of Jahannam until he proves that evil” (how will he prove it?). Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) says that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.
